disposition_mapping.rationale: Trial balance close confirmation survives as a distinct step, now supported by continuous automated reconciliation monitoring, satisfying FSP-R-10 and the cutoff discipline of KB-03.

Posting of period-end adjustments is unchanged in function and still consumes the approved adjustment schedule (FSP-R-02) and revenue cut-off evidence (FSP-R-06); estimation entries retain human accountability per KB-04.

Consolidation and intercompany elimination is merged with foreign-operation translation into a single group-accountant step, still consuming intercompany balances and transactions (FSP-R-03) per IFRS 10 (KB-14).

Translation of the foreign operation is merged with consolidation since both operate on the same adjusted trial balance; closing and average exchange rates continue to be consumed (FSP-R-04) and translation differences remain tracked per KB-07/KB-08.

Mapping to statement line items is mechanical and has no standalone survival requirement, so it is absorbed into the drafting step via an automated mapping engine, still consuming the statement line-item structure (FSP-R-05).

Drafting of primary statements and key notes survives (FSP-R-11) and continues to consume the accounting policy change and prior-period error record (FSP-R-07), preserving policy continuity and error-correction disclosure per KB-05/KB-06.

Analytical review and tie-out is restructured around a continuous analytics engine with exception-based human review, preserving the evidential trail required by KB-02; this step remains unconstrained by design but is retained for quality assurance.
Management review and approval survives (FSP-R-09), performed by the CFO and kept distinct from the drafting actor (Financial reporting), satisfying the actor-separation requirement FSP-R-08.
Release/submission is unconstrained by design and is retained unchanged as the final distribution step following approval.

steps.description: Subledger closure and reconciliation completion are continuously monitored via an automated reconciliation engine; the GL accountant confirms closed status and investigates any flagged exceptions before the trial balance is declared closed and reconciled. Period cutoff discipline (KB-03) is enforced by system-level period locks.
steps.name: Confirm trial balance close

steps.description: Approved period-end adjustments (accruals, provisions, deferrals, cut-off) are posted, with revenue cut-off verified. Mechanical recurring entries may be system-generated, but estimation-based entries (provisions, impairments, NRV write-downs) retain an accountable GL accountant per KB-04/KB-10.
steps.name: Post period-end adjustments

steps.description: Entity trial balances are consolidated and intragroup balances and transactions are identified, matched and eliminated in full (KB-14), combined with translation of the foreign subsidiary's results and position into the presentation currency using closing and average rates, with exchange differences taken to OCI (KB-07, KB-08). Combining these two group-accountant functions removes a hand-off without weakening either control, since both operate on the same adjusted trial balance base.
steps.name: Consolidate, eliminate intercompany, and translate foreign operations

steps.description: An automated mapping engine maps the consolidated and translated trial balance to the statement line-item structure (KB-02); Financial reporting then drafts the primary statements and key notes (accounting policies, revenue, FX, errors), including disclosure of policy changes and prior-period errors per KB-05/KB-06. Mapping is absorbed into drafting because it is mechanical and has no independent control requirement of its own.
inputs: Accounting policy change and prior-period error record
steps.name: Map and draft primary statements and key notes

steps.description: A continuous analytics engine performs tie-out of the draft statements to the trial balance and supporting schedules, flagging variances; Financial reporting reviews and resolves flagged exceptions, preserving the evidential trail required by KB-02.
steps.name: Automated analytical review and tie-out

steps.description: Management reviews and approves the financial statements, independently of the Financial reporting function that drafted them, preserving segregation of duties.
steps.name: Management review and approval

steps.description: The approved financial statements are released or submitted.
steps.name: Release / submission
